text:
sara: heads-up noticed our billing telemetry shows a small spike billed to org 1001 during last night's auth hotfix. digging now.
michael: timeline? which hotfix rolled?
sara: auth-normalizer v1.9 deployed 2026-02-10T21:40Z. the window is ~21:42-21:46Z. edge logs show `x-origin: org/1001` but `x-inbound-origin: org/1001/project/7/sa/worker` was present earlier.
olga: that's the collapse-on-introspect-fail fallback we enabled to avoid noisy 403s. unintended side-effect on billing.
infra-bot: auth-normalizer v1.9 deployed 2026-02-10T21:39Z -> rollout 100% 21:41Z.
billing: org/1001 tokens +6% vs project/7 -6%. accounts flagged and asked for root cause.
michael: short-term fix: preserve original origin in `x-origin-preserved` and add `x-origin-asserted: false`. sign preserved header so downstream can't spoof.
sara: agree. add telemetry `auth.origin_resolution=preserved_on_failure` and `billing.attribution_uncertain=1` increment. console should surface an "attribution uncertain" badge.
olga: security: preserved header must be treated as telemetry only unless signature validated. I'll add HMAC signing and CIDR checks.
devex: Console work: add per-account toggle "reject uncertain attribution" (returns 403) and a badge in traffic table; small API change to expose `attribution_uncertain_count`.
billing: policy: bill to the most-specific asserted identity; if none asserted, bill org but mark `attribution_uncertain` for manual review. no auto adjustments.
michael: rollout plan: quick patch to preserve+sign headers -> staging smoke -> 5% canary -> monitor `billing.attribution_uncertain` -> full roll. I'll open PR now.
sara: please run a backfill for the 21:42-21:46Z window so accounts can see affected requests.
olga: will include tests ensuring unsigned preserved headers are ignored for auth decisions. pinging infra for signing keys and CIDR list.
devex: will scope the console changes and API. thanks.
sara: thanks all "
